title: Singular genitive: words that keep -i
summary: Keep final -i and add -n in these words: bussi (“bus”) → bussin.
objectives: Keep final -i and add -n in these words: bussi (“bus”) → bussin.

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: The genitive is a case form. It can link a word to an owner or another noun. Here you practise the word form; later lessons show its uses in sentences.
Keep final -i and add -n in these words. Many newer -i words behave this way, but spelling alone cannot tell you every word's stem.
keyPoints: Learn the word with its stem; the last letter alone does not identify every pattern.
